rationale.complete: Round 1 done: synthetic validation (which found and fixed a future-conditioning bias), dated predictions, 32 per-period folders plus 11 spanning NE folders, scorecard, lever taxonomy; confirmatory script written and dry-run. Holdout not run; nudge class rests on G51; content measures for steps need an agent-centered variant.
rationale.faithfulness: The decomposition beats its placebo nulls for nudges, human messages, mentions and erasure, and the predicted escape-only signature (both, rho ~0.5) holds for nudges, but most class/direction predictions failed (P2, P3 behavior, P4), P5 holds in 3/4 parts, and scaffold steps are underpowered. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1; no holdout.
rationale.usefulness: Near-actionable operator rules (one directed nudge unsticks idle agents and also tilts them; mentions steer content not activity; goals change topics in regime III; context resets make agents work more steadily for ~20 min), computable from logs. Single-period support for nudges and convention-dependence of the split keep it below a validated lever.

one_line: No lever is a pure catalyst: nudges unstick and tilt idle agents (escape x1.5, idle share -0.07); mentions steer content, not activity.
